confirmation_rereview.summary: Maximum minutes a confirmation re-review of a fix takes, from its spawn to its verdict, reading only the fix's delta.

backlog_revision.summary: Maximum minutes a one-story technical Backlog Planning revision takes end to end, from begin-revision to approval.

requirement_technical.summary: Maximum minutes a technical Requirement takes from intake to its approval.

delivery_and_execution_planning.summary: Maximum minutes Delivery Planning plus Execution Planning take for one story, from the proposal's start to the plan's publication.

story_end_to_end.summary: Maximum minutes one story takes end to end, from its Requirement's intake to its Delivery's merge.

qa_lifecycle_gate.summary: Maximum minutes one runtime lifecycle check or verification rehearsal command takes, from its start to its recorded result.

live_run.summary: Maximum minutes one QA live run of one live group or combined groups takes, from its start to its record.

live_step.summary: Maximum minutes one live step that the live progress adapter reports takes, from its first observation to the next step's.

manual_scenario.summary: Maximum minutes one owner-run or manual verification scenario takes, from its handoff to its recorded output.

freeze.summary: Maximum minutes freezing one verification candidate takes, from its start to its frozen session.

pre_handoff.summary: Maximum minutes one pre-handoff regression run takes, from its start to its record.
